column3: NASB moves “because he was a man of war” to the end and supplies “was allotted.”
“the lot was made” renders “it belonged”; “the male descendants” renders “the males.”
“according to the command of the LORD” renders “to the mouth of the LORD.”
“east of Shechem” renders “on the face of Shechem.”
“the brook” renders “the wadi”; NASB puts “these cities … Manasseh” in parentheses, and “it ended at the sea” renders “its extremities were toward the sea.”
“towns” renders “daughters”; “the third is Napheth” renders “the three of the heights,” and the meaning is uncertain.
“persisted in living” renders “was determined to dwell.”
“did not drive them out completely” renders the doubled verb “surely did not dispossess.”
“is not enough for us” renders “will not be found for us”; “towns” renders “daughters.”
“to its farthest borders” renders “its extremities”; “even though … and though” renders “for … for.”
